paragraphs:
(Achi is one of Benjamin’s ten sons, [Genesis 46:21](https://www.sefaria.org/Genesis.46.21).)
The Achai mentioned in [Berakhot 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.14a.3) was Rabbi Chiyya’s reciter of baraitot. He recited them before Rabbi Chiyya and asked him a question.

notes.text: The biblical parenthesis and the rabbinic notice appear juxtaposed under the same name. This is a source-boundary problem, not evidence that the biblical figure lived in Rabbi Chiyya’s time.
Achai asks Rabbi Chiyya whether one may interrupt the reading of Hallel or the Megillah. The biblical name and the school reciter occur in separate settings.

Hyman’s print (vol. I, p. 136) places the biblical parenthesis immediately after the heading אחי and then gives the rabbinic notice. Genesis 46:21 lists Achi among Benjamin’s sons. In Berakhot 14a, Achai of Rabbi Chiyya’s school asks Rabbi Chiyya about interrupting the reading of Hallel or the Megillah. The two passages concern namesakes.
